findings.problem: Browser Print/PDF is acknowledged but lacks the behavior needed to satisfy the committed current-revision delivery contract. Technical plan C captures immutable source/options and ties readiness and target notes to a prepared artifact, while Slice 4 includes print in desktop/mobile delivery parity. In the repository, exportHelpers.printPdf() directly calls window.print(), prepareDocumentExport() returns only file or clipboard data, and MobileExportBar handles PDF through a separate print callback. The plan does not say how printing waits for the matching document revision, PDF projection, and required assets to render, what happens when the source/document changes while waiting, or what retry means when there is no retained PDF file. A current-source file export controller alone cannot establish these print guarantees.
findings.remedy: Define a Print/PDF branch in the shared delivery contract: print the requested revision/options only after its PDF render and required assets are ready; invalidate or restart preparation if the request changes; expose render failure and retry without printing stale DOM. State whether retry re-renders the current request or retains a print snapshot. Keep the outcome 'print dialog opened / external completion unknown' and do not imply a downloadable prepared PDF artifact. Include a regression where compilation/assets are delayed and Print is requested after an edit or document switch.
